notes.title: Synthetic Hopes - Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Patch 1.0.2 - Hotfix[/h2]

Hi everyone!

Back with a new update focused on fixing bugs and some uninteresting skips based on player feedback.

What changed:
[list]
[*]Fixed some light hitboxes and shadows in the pools in the lab section
[*]Fixed a skip in the lab where you could trigger the fall of a platform from below
[*]Slowed down the boxes with cameras attached at the end of the lab. They also aim down instead of at an angle to make it fairer.
[*]Fixed a bunch of cameras' hitboxes where you could barely slip past with a well timed jump
[*]Added some killboxes in rotating sets to prevent the player from being stuck
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Synthetic Hopes - Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h2]Patch 1.0.1 - Hotfix[/h2][p][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]
Big thanks to everyone that started playing Synthetic Hopes.
This updates includes small fixes based on player experience and feedbacks.

What changed:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed softlock in the last environment where light switches wouldn't reset after death and could lock you of picking up resources[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed softlock in the labyrinthic rotating set where you would get stuck in walls after respawning.[/p][/*][*][p]Slowed down rotating obstacles towards the end of the game to make it a bit easier[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Update - Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[p]We updated our demo for the Steam Next Fest. Be sure to check it out!

We updated some visual and sound effects, most notably on the main action of the player: shooting clouds and platforms! We fixed some bugs and added menu options and rebindable keys.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Here are the full patchnotes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New SFX et VFX on arm actions[/p][/*][*][p]Remade the big tree room[/p][/*][*][p]New menu tabs[/p][/*][*][p]New bindings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Localization options for the interface - added French, Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, German, Italian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese & Korean[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed particles in some levels[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Platform hitbox blocking player while spawning[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Sounds of platforms all playing at the same time when dying[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Also check out the Release Date Trailer here: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zahqBt56mK4"][/dynamiclink][/p]
